description: This file defines the AddOn interface and its nested interface AddOnResourceMapping, which specify methods for managing add-on resources and metadata within the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: AddOn
classes.description: An interface representing an add-on component with methods to retrieve its metadata and resource mapping.

classes.name: AddOn.AddOnResourceMapping
classes.description: A nested interface within AddOn that defines methods for resource styleable array mapping and attribute ID conversions.

methods.name: getRemoteStyleableArrayFromLocal
methods.description: Converts a local styleable array to its remote equivalent.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version of the add-on or resource mapping.

methods.name: getLocalAttrId
methods.description: Retrieves the local attribute ID corresponding to a remote attribute ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the add-on.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the add-on.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the add-on.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description: Returns the package name associated with the add-on.

methods.name: getPackageContext
methods.description: Provides the Context for the add-on's package, nullable.

methods.name: getSortIndex
methods.description: Returns the sort index for ordering add-ons.

methods.name: getResourceMapping
methods.description: Returns the resource mapping object for the add-on.
